svg.aria-label: Quickselect for rank k = 4 in 7 2 9 4 1 6 3, call 1: the Lomuto partition of the call's range (grey cells are outside it), then the side that holds rank 4. call 1: quickselect(lo = 0, hi = 6, k = 4), pivot = a[6] = 3:. j = 0 7 < 3? no: [7 2 9 4 1 6 3] (j at 0, k at 4) (skip; i stays at −1). j = 1 2 < 3: take: [2 7 9 4 1 6 3] (i at 0, j at 1, k at 4) (i = 0: swap a[0] and a[1]). j = 2 9 < 3? no: [2 7 9 4 1 6 3] (i at 0, j at 2, k at 4) (skip). j = 3 4 < 3? no: [2 7 9 4 1 6 3] (i at 0, j at 3, k at 4) (skip). j = 4 1 < 3: take: [2 1 9 4 7 6 3] (i at 1, j at 4, k at 4) (i = 1: swap a[1] and a[4]). j = 5 6 < 3? no: [2 1 9 4 7 6 3] (i at 1, j at 5, k at 4) (skip). place swap(a[i+1], a[hi]): [2 1 3 4 7 6 9] (p at 2, k at 4) (p = 2 < k = 4: recurse right on (3, 6); 6 compares).
svg.text: call 1: quickselect(lo = 0, hi = 6, k = 4), pivot = a[6] = 3
